pr_title: Make user and role name constraint consistent with max document ID.
pr_body:
This change tries to make user and role name constraints consistent with
what is currently allowed to store in the native realm (512).
Because the document IDs are prefixed by either `user-` or `role-`,
the actual possible max length is a funky looking 507 chars.
If we choose (in the future) to allow more than 507 chars we should
either consider increasing the max allowed size for document ID or
consider hashing names longer than 507 in order to fit into document ID.

Note: File realm validation is left as it was and allows max 1024 chars. 
I'm not sure if this is something we should reflect in the documentation.

Closes #66020

issue_context.title: Max length constaint for role/user name should be more consistent
issue_context.body:
The security related [validation](https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/blob/master/x-pack/plugin/core/src/main/java/org/elasticsearch/xpack/core/security/support/Validation.java#L22) mandates a maximum length of 1024 characters for username and role name. This limitation is also documented in following places:
* [Defining roles](https://www.elastic.co/guide/en/elasticsearch/reference/master/defining-roles.html)
* [Put user API](https://www.elastic.co/guide/en/elasticsearch/reference/current/security-api-put-user.html#security-api-put-user-path-params)
* [`elasticsearch-users` command](https://www.elastic.co/guide/en/elasticsearch/reference/current/users-command.html#_description_10)*

However, when the user and role are stored in the security index, their names are used to form the document ID, for which the indexing code has a max length [constraint](https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/blob/20d6fbcd551cc9b9cf1dbb45fac062b101dfa4a8/server/src/main/java/org/elasticsearch/action/index/IndexRequest.java#L215-L218) of 512 bytes. And this 512 bytes constraint is what takes the ultimate effect. Also because the document IDs are prefixed by either `user-` or `role-`, the actual possible max length is a bit less than 512 bytes.

When the users/roles are defined in files, they are no longer limited by the document ID and in this case, they can be up to 1024 characters. So this means the above documentation for `elasticsearch-users` command is accurate. However, I wonder whether this difference between file and index is necessary or intended.

PS: role mapping has the same issue with document ID. But security validation does not touch it (probably because the length is enforced at HTTP layer as request URL). Also we don't have documentation about its length limit. So it is less of an issue.
